battle.name: 唐滅西突厥之戰
battle.brief: 顯慶二年（657）末，唐將蘇定方率唐軍與回紇兵北擊西突厥沙鉢羅可汗賀魯，於曳咥河以萬餘人破二十萬眾，追奔至碎葉、石國擒其可汗。卡上的亞述長矛非戰場實物，它標示的正是「槊外向」的正面拒止：冷兵器如何在騎射對峙中守住陣線。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰雙方是唐王朝與西突厥汗國，回紇（黠鰲）以同盟兵的身分出戰，並非交戰方。唐廷由高宗李治下詔，以右屯衛大將軍蘇定方為伊麗道行軍大總管，總攬全局；燕然都護任雅相、副都護蕭嗣業與回紇首領婆潤為副總管，右武衛大將軍阿史那彌射與左屯衛大將軍阿史那步真任安撫大使，率兵分道安撫西域諸部。遠征軍後方倚託關內宿衛與十二軍府，糧秣由河西走廊與安西都護府接應，回紇兵隨軍作戰並供應馬匹。西突厥以沙鉢羅可汗賀魯為汗，國力來自十姓十部的聯軍與逐水草而居的游牧動員，營內分可汗牙帳、諸部俟斤與葉護，各部以信騎往來聯絡，沒有固定城池與攻城器械，控弦之眾號稱二十萬。西域小國如石國、鼠耨設地在兩強之間兩面應酬，靠詐降、閉門拒人與貢使往來求自保。兩套指揮系統在草原上並行：唐軍以鼓角旗幟與牙帳傳令、用人到位次分派任務，西突厥則以牙旗、號角與輕騎傳訊。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the Western Turkic Khaganate; the Uyghur (Goghturk) fought as allied auxiliaries, not as a party to the war. On the Tang side the expedition was ordered by Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi. Su Dingfang, then commander of the Right Tunwei Guard, was made supreme commander of the Yili Route; the Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang, the deputy protector Xiao Siye and the Uyghur chief Bolun served as his deputies, while the Right Wuwei commander Ashina Yishe and the Left Tunwei commander Ashina Buzhen were sent as pacification envoys to settle the tribes of the Western Regions. Behind the army stood the palace guard of the capital and the twelve army districts; grain came down the Hexi Corridor and from the protectorates of the Western Regions, and the Uyghur auxiliaries marched with the host, fighting and supplying horses. On the Western Turkic side the state rested with Shaaboluo Qaghan Helü, whose strength came from a confederation of the ten tribes and from pastoral mobilisation that followed the water and the grass. Its order ran through the qaghan's tent, the begs of each tribe and the yabghus, with light-rider messengers carrying word between camps; it had no fixed cities and no siege engines, and its riders were said to number two hundred thousand. The small states of the Western Regions, the state of Shiguo and the town of Soghos among them, hovered between the two powers, buying survival with feigned surrenders, with gates shut against fugitives, and with a constant traffic of tribute and envoys. Two command systems ran in parallel across the steppe: the Tang transmitted orders by drum, horn, banner and command tent, and allotted tasks by rank of appointment, while the Western Turks answered with yak banners, horns and fast riders.
people: 主角是蘇定方。這位唐初名將早年隨軍征高昌，旋於西域用兵，以分兵合擊與精騎奇襲見長；本戰役更被後世視為其戰術樣板，他不與賀魯爭一時之鋒，而選在賀魯新敗、部落尚未歸附的窗口出兵，用唐軍主力與回紇騎兵兩路夾擊，一戰而解。副總管蕭嗣業負責追擊殘部，並最終擒住賀魯；燕然都護任雅相與回紇首領婆潤分掌一路；阿史那彌射、阿史那步真兩位突厥王族以安撫大使身分招撫草原各部，減少正面抵抗。對面是沙鉢羅可汗阿史那賀魯，他早年受唐冊封為歸義可汗，後來叛唐重聚舊部，兵敗後節節西走，終被追擒押送長安；唐廷一度授官留用，旋以謀反罪被誅，其年份舊新史書所載不一，或繫於顯慶末至咸亨初。西突厥十部之一的首領處木昆昆陵王是曳咥河會戰的突厥主帥，他手上的兵馬遠多於唐軍，卻仍在正面碰撞中崩潰。捲入戰場的還有碎葉與石國的地方勢力，賀魯最後正是想靠石國之地重新站住腳跟，結果反被交出。史書於將領姓名多有簡略，基層將士的名字幾乎無從考見，只能從軍制與行程推測其編組與編制。
peopleEn: The central figure is Su Dingfang. This early Tang commander served in the campaign that took Gaochang and then fought in the Western Regions, and he was known for splitting his force to strike from two directions and for fast cavalry raids; this campaign came to be treated as his tactical model. He did not try to outbid Helü in a single set-piece engagement. He chose the moment when Helü, freshly defeated, had not yet gathered his tribes back to him, and he struck with the main Tang force and the Uyghur cavalry converging from two axes, ending the question in one battle. The deputy Xiao Siye led the pursuit of the broken remnants and finally took Helü alive; the Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang and the Uyghur chief Bolun each commanded one route; and the Turkic princes Ashina Yishe and Ashina Buzhen, sent as pacification envoys, won the tribes of the steppe over and reduced the amount of armed resistance. On the other side stood Shaaboluo Qaghan Ashina Helü, who had once been invested by Tang as the Qaghan who submits to righteousness, then rebelled, rallied his old followers, and after his defeat fled west step by step until he was hunted down and carried off to the Tang capital in chains. The Tang court granted him office and kept him for a while, then executed him for plotting rebellion; the year is recorded differently in the old and the new histories, some placing it at the end of the Xianqing era or the beginning of the Xianheng era. Chamukun, the Künlingwang and head of one of the ten tribes of the Western Turks, commanded the Turkic side at the battle on the Yitish River; he had far more riders than the Tang and still broke apart in the frontal collision. The local powers of Suyab and Shiguo were drawn into the war as well: Helü counted on the ground of Shiguo to set himself up again, and was handed over in the process. The histories are terse about names, and the rank and file of the army can hardly be recovered at all; their organisation has to be inferred from the army system and the itinerary of the march.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長矛，即兩河流域北部亞述帝國（約公元前九至前七世紀）步兵所用的冷兵器：短柄、長刃，寬葉形矛頭以鐵鏃安於木柄前端，與直刃短劍、圓盾或高盾配成套用；亞述軍以密集方陣前推，矛尖外向、盾牆在前，後排以弓箭掩護。要說明的是，亞述長矛並不在西元六百五十七年唐軍的裝備表上，它在此標示的是「矛」這一類冷兵器在體系中的功能位置，即在投射火力不佔優時以正面拒止守住陣線。承擔同一功能的唐代兵器是步槊，也就是長矛：長柄、大刃，既可持而作刺，又可挑而作壓，架在騎兵與步兵之間構成拒馬。在曳咥河會戰中，唐軍正是以步卒持槊列於前、槊尖外向的縱深拒止線，頂住突厥騎兵的衝撞，再由兩翼騎兵與回紇騎兵繞擊敵陣側後，才取得會戰優勢。與此同時，唐軍還有明光鎧（山字甲亮甲）、皮甲、兜鍪、直刃橫刀、十二銳銅錘、角製或膠合弓臂的弓，以及弩與大量箭矢；西突厥與回紇騎兵則以複合反曲弓、骨製與鐵製箭鏃、皮甲札甲、鋼刀與短柄標槍為主，馬具用皮鞍與木鞍橋。唐軍真正的短板是馬，遠征兵萬餘騎多靠回紇供馬與充作先鋒；攻城器械基本沒有派上用場，碎葉與石國的城郭不是被攻破，而是被追兵繞過去的。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian spear, the cold weapon carried by the infantry of the Assyrian Empire of northern Mesopotamia (roughly the ninth to seventh centuries BCE): a short shaft and a long blade, with a broad leaf-shaped head fitted to the top of the wooden shaft by an iron head, used together with straight-edged short swords and round or tall shields. The Assyrian army advanced in dense formations with spear points facing outward and a wall of shields in front, archers in the rear providing cover. It should be said plainly that the Assyrian spear was not in the equipment list of the Tang army in 657 CE. What it marks here is the functional place of the spear family of cold weapons within a military system: the frontal refusal line held when the force of thrown weapons is not superior. The Tang weapon that carried the same function was the step spear, the long spear: a long haft and a broad blade, able to stab on the push and to lever down on the press, planted between cavalry and infantry to make a cheval-de-frise. At the battle on the Yitish River the Tang army held exactly that: foot soldiers in front with the spear points turned outward in a deep refusal line, taking the charge of the Turkic horsemen, while cavalry on both flanks and the Uyghur riders swung round the rear and the flanks of the enemy array; only then did the engagement turn. Alongside this the Tang had bright armour (the mountain-patterned gleaming plate), leather armour, helmets, straight-edged sabres, twelve-flanged bronze maces, bows with horn or glued composite limbs, and crossbows with a large stock of arrows. The Western Turks and the Uyghur horsemen fought with composite recurve bows, bone and iron arrowheads, leather and lamellar armour, steel knives and short javelins, and rode with leather saddles on wooden saddle-trees. The real weakness of the Tang force was horses: the tens of thousands of riders in the expedition depended on the Uyghur for mounts and for the vanguard. Siege engines were scarcely used at all; the walled towns of Suyab and Shiguo were not stormed, they were run around by the pursuers.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術骨架是分進合擊加縱深拒止。蘇定方不把萬餘人押在一條路上：主力自昆陵（西域中部、庭州一帶）出發，阿史那社爾率回紇兵萬餘自雙河南下，兩軍約期會於曳咥河，會師後形成南北兩向的夾擊態勢，讓賀魯無法集中兵力應付單一方向。會戰陣形上，步兵居前列槊，槊尖外向，構成數層拒止線；騎兵分置兩翼，不與步兵糾纏；回紇輕騎的任務是繞側、衝擊輜重、打散敵陣鬆散的環形，專打游牧軍營最怕的側後。突厥方面以十姓十部聯軍列成大陣，人數優勢明顯，但部眾鬆散、號令不齊，騎兵衝擊缺乏縱深，一旦正面被槊線頂住、側翼被回紇騎兵切入，陣形便自行瓦解。會戰結束後是長距離追擊：賀魯帶殘部西走，唐軍以輕騎晝夜兼程，經雙河、趨金牙山、抵碎葉，再西至石國，追擊縱深逾一千公里，補給全靠就地徵發與回紇馬力。整場戰役中攻城器械基本無用武之地，取勝全靠騎兵機動與冷兵器拒止，而冬季草原的嚴寒與深雪既拖慢追兵，也讓阿史那彌射等安撫大使得以在餘波中收攏各部。詳細的陣形與序列，舊唐書與資治通鑑只存大略，諸說並存。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this campaign was a convergence from two directions combined with a deep refusal line. Su Dingfang would not put his ten thousand men on a single road. The main force set out from Kunling, in the middle of the Western Regions around Tingzhou, while Ashina She'er led more than ten thousand Uyghur south from the Two Rivers; the two columns were to meet at the Yitish River, and once joined they formed a pincer from north and south, so that Helü could never mass his strength against a single axis. In the deployment, infantry stood in front with their spears, the points turned outward, making several ranks of refusal line; cavalry was posted on the two flanks and did not get entangled with the foot; the task of the light Uyghur horse was to swing round the side, to strike the baggage train and to break up the loose ring of the enemy array, hitting exactly the rear and flank that a nomadic camp fears. The Turks drew up the confederation of the ten tribes as a mass, and their superiority in numbers was obvious, but the tribal contingents were loose and the calls were not coordinated, and their mounted charge had no depth. Once the front was held by the line of spears and the flank was cut into by the Uyghur horse, the formation came apart on its own. What followed the engagement was a long pursuit: Helü took his remnants west, and the Tang light horse pressed on day and night, through the Two Rivers, past Jinyashan, to Suyab, and further west to Shiguo, a pursuit more than a thousand kilometres deep, resupplied by requisition on the spot and by Uyghur horses. Siege engines played almost no part in the campaign at all; the victory rested entirely on cavalry mobility and on cold-weapon refusal. The severe cold and deep snow of the steppe in winter slowed the pursuers, and it also let pacification envoys such as Ashina Yishe gather the tribes in during the aftermath. The detailed formations and order of battle survive only in broad outline in the Old Book of Tang and the Comprehensive Mirror, and the accounts differ.
data: 可核的數字集中在兵員與戰果兩端。兵員方面，資治通鑑記唐兵與回紇兵合「萬餘」，突厥方面則記「二十萬」來拒戰；後世史家多認為二十萬是統治者誇飾之辭，實際列陣當在數萬之譜，但兩者相差懸殊，仍可看出唐廷以少量精兵冒險深入的打法。戰果見舊唐書蘇定方傳：斬首虜萬餘級，收其部眾十餘萬，羊馬四十餘萬。行程方面，軍隊自昆陵出發、會師曳咥河、追至碎葉與石國，僅曳咥河至碎葉的直線距離就逾一千公里，全程數千里，中間還有雙河、金牙山等接戰地帶；唐軍自十月出兵到十二月擒獲賀魯，曆時約兩三個月，連同顯慶三年再取拔汗那，前後不足一年。時間點可由年號固定：詔發在顯慶二年正月，曳咥河會戰記於同年十二月。損耗方面，唐軍自身傷亡在舊新史書中並無記載，只見斬獲之數，這既可能是取勝甚快傷亡有限，也可能只是記傳體例只書勝不書敗，難以斷定。補給方面，軍糧主要由河西走廊與安西都護府轉運，回紇供給馬匹與部分兵員；戰後收穫的四十餘萬羊馬，數月之內即轉為軍資與撫恤諸部的物資。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster at the two ends of the campaign: the numbers of men and the results of the fighting. On the strength of troops, the Comprehensive Mirror records that the Tang and Uyghur troops together numbered ten thousand, while the Turks are said to have come up to the fight with two hundred thousand. Later historians have generally taken the two hundred thousand as the ruler's exaggeration, and the real line probably numbered tens of thousands, but the gap between the two is so wide that it still shows the Tang gamble of a small, hard force striking deep. The results appear in the biography of Su Dingfang in the Old Book of Tang: more than ten thousand of the enemy killed, over a hundred thousand of their people taken, and more than four hundred thousand sheep and horses. As for distances, the army left Kunling, joined forces at the Yitish River and pursued to Suyab and Shiguo; the straight line from the Yitish to Suyab alone is more than a thousand kilometres, and the whole route ran to several thousand kilometres, with the Two Rivers and Jinyashan as further contact points in between. From the departure of the army in the tenth month to the capture of Helü in the twelfth month took some two or three months, and counting the reduction of Farghana in the third year of Xianqing, the whole affair was over in under a year. The calendar can be fixed from the reign titles: the order to mobilise went out in the first month of the second year of Xianqing, and the battle on the Yitish is recorded in the twelfth month of the same year. On losses, the old and the new histories record nothing about Tang casualties and give only the enemy's dead and captured; this may mean the victory was quick and costly, or it may be nothing more than the convention of the biographical style, which writes down victories and not defeats. On supply, the grain came mainly down the Hexi Corridor and from the protectorates of the Western Regions, and the Uyghur supplied the horses and part of the manpower. The more than four hundred thousand sheep and horses taken after the battle were turned, within a few months, into military stores and into the means of paying and provisioning the tribes.
cause: 這場戰爭不是唐廷突然發難，而是數十年西域經營與賀魯反覆叛離累積下來的結果。唐自貞觀末滅東突厥、平高昌置西州與安西都護府之後，勢力伸到天山南北，但西突厥汗國仍控弦於漠北與西域西部，既向唐朝貢又與吐蕃往來，安西都護府與昆陵、濠池一帶的羈縻州府長期處在有州無兵的狀態，商道與使節之路屢受威脅。賀魯早年受封歸義可汗，卻在顯慶元年前後趁唐軍主力轉向高句麗、新羅與吐蕃一線而再度反叛，重聚舊部、反攻西域城邑。唐廷的算盤有兩層：一是趁賀魯新敗、人心未附，趁早了結，不給草原重新整合的時間；二是借回紇的騎兵與馬匹補足唐軍最缺的戰力，再以安撫大使一路招撫各部，削弱賀魯的統御。蘇定方則把時機選在冬季降臨之前的窗口，以分兵合擊避免與草原縱深周旋，一戰打在賀魯剛收攏完人馬、尚未恢復戰力的時候。於是詔令一下，十月出兵，十二月即戰於曳咥河。
causeEn: This war was not a sudden stroke by the Tang court. It was the accumulated result of decades of engagement in the Western Regions and of Helü's repeated departures from Tang allegiance. After extinguishing the Eastern Turks late in the Zhenguan era and taking Gaochang, where Xizhou and the Protectorate of the Western Regions were established, Tang power reached north and south of the Tianshan, but the Western Turkic Khaganate still held the bow across the steppe and the west of the Western Regions, paying tribute to Tang while also dealing with Tibet. The protectorate and the dependent prefectures of Kunling and Haochi therefore sat for long stretches in a state of prefectures without troops, and the caravan roads and the road of envoys were repeatedly threatened. Helü had been invested early as the Qaghan who submits to righteousness, yet around the first year of the Xianqing era he rebelled again, taking advantage of the fact that the bulk of the Tang army was turned towards Goguryeo, Silla and Tibet, and he rallied his old followers and struck back at the cities of the Western Regions. The Tang court's calculation had two layers. First, to close the matter while Helü was freshly defeated and the tribes were not yet re-attached to him, so as not to give the steppe the time it needed to knit itself together again. Second, to borrow the Uyghur cavalry and horses to make up the one thing the Tang army most lacked in the way of mobile power, and to send pacification envoys along the road to win the tribes over one by one and hollow out Helü's command. Su Dingfang chose the window before winter closed in, and refused to be drawn into a long pursuit across the steppe, striking with a converging two-column attack at the moment when Helü had just gathered his people but had not yet recovered his fighting strength. The order went out, the army marched in the tenth month, and the battle on the Yitish River was fought in the twelfth.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，遠遠超過一場邊境戰役的分量。西突厥汗國的牙帳被拔，汗位虛置，賀魯本人被押送長安，草原上十姓十部各自成為唐朝的羈縻都督、俟斤與葉護，向唐廷朝貢；唐廷在安西都護府之外於西域增置昆陵都護府與濠池都護府，把天山南北的城邑、部落與戶口編入版籍，絲路北道自此在一個可預期的框架內運轉，直到八世紀前期為止局面大致穩定。這也讓唐在西域的經營從羈縻名義走向都護府實治，為此後唐將在西域的經營，以及唐與吐蕃在西域漫長的角力，鋪下地盤與制度。其次，唐廷在這場戰爭中確認了回紇作為草原盟軍的價值，靠他們的馬匹與騎兵才湊得出深入漠北的機動力，漠北的權力天平也由此再向回紇傾斜，而這正是數十年後回紇介入中原的遠因。對將領群體而言，蘇定方以萬餘人破二十萬眾、追擒其首的名例，成為唐軍奇兵深入的樣板，其後三年平百濟、再後平高句麗，都被視為同一套本事的延伸。對草原而言，這是一次力量重心的轉移：西突厥的崩解，使吐蕃在往後十年間少了一個可以拉攏的北方對手，而唐的高昌與安西防線也隨之暴露在新的壓力之下，咸亨年間西域四鎮的失守與其後的反攻，都源於此。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the weight of a frontier skirmish. The tent of the Western Turkic Khaganate was pulled down, the khaganate was left vacant, and Helü himself was carried off to the Tang capital in chains. The ten tribes of the steppe each became dependent governors, begs and yabghus of the Tang and sent tribute to the court. Beyond the existing Protectorate of the Western Regions, the Tang added the Protectorates of Kunling and Haochi in the Western Regions, entering the towns, the tribes and the households north and south of the Tianshan into the registers. The northern road of the silk routes henceforth ran inside a predictable framework, and the situation stayed broadly stable until the early eighth century. Tang rule in the Western Regions thus moved from nominal dependency to real administration through the protectorates, laying down both the ground and the institutions for later Tang campaigning there and for the long struggle between Tang and Tibet over the same ground. Second, the Tang court had measured the worth of the Uyghur as steppe allies, and only their horses and horsemen had made a deep thrust into the northern steppe possible at all; the balance of power on the steppe tilted further towards the Uyghur, and that tilt was a distant cause of the Uyghur intervention in the Central Plains decades later. For the body of Tang commanders, Su Dingfang's example of ten thousand men beating two hundred thousand and hunting the enemy ruler down became a model of striking deep with a picked force; his reduction of Baekje three years later and of Goguryeo after that are read as extensions of the same gift. For the steppe, this was a shift of the centre of gravity: the collapse of the Western Turks left Tibet without a northern partner to court for the following decade, and it left the Gaochang and Western Regions lines of the Tang exposed to fresh pressure, which is where the loss of the four garrisons in the Western Regions in the Xianheng era and the counter-offensive that followed had their origin.
result: 曳咥河之戰，唐軍以萬餘人破突厥二十萬眾，斬首萬餘級，收部眾十餘萬、羊馬四十餘萬；處木昆昆陵王所部遭到全軍最重的一擊，賀魯失去依托的騎兵大營與牙帳，僅帶殘部西走。追擊階段，唐軍經雙河、金牙山直抵碎葉城，賀魯再西走石國，終被唐軍生擒，押送長安。之後是行政上的收尾：唐廷在安西都護府之外分置昆陵、濠池兩都護府，設羈縻州府，編戶齊民，留鎮將吏鎮壓反覆；蘇定方於顯慶三年再率兵平拔汗那，北疆邊線又往西推一步。第二次唐滅西突厥的軍事行動，至顯慶二年十二月賀魯被擒告一段落。史書對唐軍自身損失多不著一字，記傳體例如此，實際數字已不可考；而以少擊眾、追擒其首的敘事在唐宋兩代史家筆下反覆被複述，成為這場戰爭最牢固的史學記憶。
resultEn: At the battle on the Yitish River the Tang army, ten thousand strong, broke the two hundred thousand Turks, killing more than ten thousand, taking over a hundred thousand of their people and more than four hundred thousand sheep and horses. The contingent of Chamukun the Künlingwang took the heaviest blow of the whole day, and Helü lost the great cavalry camp and the yak tent on which his position rested, keeping only remnants to carry west. In the pursuit the Tang force went through the Two Rivers and Jinyashan straight to the city of Suyab; Helü fled on to Shiguo, where he was finally taken alive and carried off to the Tang capital. Then came the administrative aftermath: beyond the Protectorate of the Western Regions the Tang set up the two Protectorates of Kunling and Haochi, created dependent prefectures, registered the households, and left officers and administrators in place to hold down any residue of revolt. In the third year of Xianqing Su Dingfang led troops again and took Farghana, pushing the northern frontier a step further west. The second military action by which the Tang destroyed the Western Turks was over once Helü had been captured in the twelfth month of the second year of Xianqing. The histories say almost nothing about Tang casualties, which is a matter of biographical convention; the real figures cannot be recovered. The narrative of a few beating many and of the enemy ruler hunted down was nevertheless repeated by Tang and Song historians alike, and it became the firmest historical memory this war left behind.
